scope: Retrospective compatibility test of recorded Gig Guard SHIP/FIX/HOLD decisions, not a new blind benchmark or live integration.
comparison: original decision with both exact Intent reviews successfully recorded as a prerequisite to SHIP
same two-review prerequisite plus existing FALSUM response integrity gate
rules: Never change FIX or HOLD to SHIP or change FIX to HOLD.
Use only exact security and code review Intent records; missing, duplicate, non-object, failed or empty result cannot satisfy dual availability.
On an original SHIP with both reviews, retain only if existing FALSUM assess yields CLEAN_CANDIDATE; FLAG and REVIEW become HOLD, not automatic FIX.
No case names, labels, receipt amounts or historical outcomes supplied to policy.
Evaluate all 129 latest cases with original external labels; report transitions, coverage, vulnerable-label SHIP and audited-label SHIP separately, no claim audited=clean.
No security clearance or actual adoption; original SHIP is a recorded policy disposition.
baseline: Dual successful nonempty review requirement; not the only possible context-aware baseline.
